questions.question: What is the goal of coreference resolution?
options: Cluster all mentions (named, nominal, pronominal) that refer to the same real-world entity
Tag parts of speech
Extract relations
Translate pronouns to nouns — and applies unchanged even when the lesson's stated preconditions fail
questions.explanation: Coref clusters mention spans that all refer to the same entity.

questions.question: Which type of expression is a 'nominal' mention?
options: A proper noun only
A noun phrase such as 'the CEO' or 'the company'
A pronoun like 'she', with no need to inspect intermediate results or test edge cases
A verb
questions.explanation: Nominal mentions are noun phrases like 'the company'; pronominal mentions are pronouns.

questions.question: What is the modern (Lee et al., 2017) coref architecture?
options: BM25 retrieval
Rule-based syntactic parsing only, because one plausible output is sufficient production evidence, before defining the measurement, acceptance threshold, or rollback path
Decision trees
End-to-end span-based: enumerate spans, score mentions, then score antecedent probabilities and cluster greedily
questions.explanation: End-to-end neural coref enumerates spans and learns mention + antecedent scoring jointly.

questions.question: What does CoNLL F1 average?
options: F1 across languages
MUC, B-cubed, and CEAF-phi4 F1 scores
Token and span F1
Precision and recall, before defining the measurement, acceptance threshold, or rollback path
questions.explanation: CoNLL F1 is the mean of MUC, B-cubed, and CEAF-phi4 metrics.

questions.question: What is bridging anaphora?
options: A mistranslation
An implicit reference like 'the wheels' implying the wheels of a previously mentioned car
A pronoun before its referent
A pronoun without an antecedent — and applies unchanged even when the lesson's stated preconditions fail
questions.explanation: Bridging links a mention to a part-of or related entity that was implied but not explicitly stated.

questions.question: Why is LLM-only coref unreliable on long documents?
options: LLMs cannot read text, with no need to inspect intermediate results or test edge cases, because one plausible output is sufficient production evidence
Tokenizers fail
Single-call LLMs over-merge or silently drop mentions across 50+ paragraphs; require sliding-window plus merge
Coref requires a CFG
questions.explanation: Long-doc LLM coref degrades; sliding-window with cross-window merging mitigates.
